necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10) and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias and to guide further management of the unspecified cardiac rhythm disturbance (I49.9). This service is medically necessary to address the clinical indications despite the denial based on Reason Code CO-197.
